authenticity_review: The image suffers from severe semantic hallucinations: every cow has bright yellow/orange flame-like shapes attached to or inside their ears, which are biologically impossible and represent a major AI artifact. Additionally, the lower legs and hooves show structural collapse where they merge into the grass texture without clear definition. The pose auditor reports HIGH artifact risk with ~50% low-confidence keypoints across hind limbs, front limbs, and face regions, confirming widespread anatomical uncertainty. These defects significantly reduce authenticity despite correct count and color.
key_defects: Flame-like yellow/orange artifacts on all cow ears (semantic hallucination)
Lower legs/hooves melting into grass texture (structural collapse)
High proportion of low-confidence pose keypoints indicating anatomical instability
Body fusion between background cows reducing individual separation
